The '''Galaxy-15 ion engine''' was a model of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and used on their [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigates]]. [[IG-88B|IG-88]] outfitted his [[IG-2000/Legends|IG-2000]] [[Aggressor assault fighter/Legends|assault fighter]] with a Galaxy-15 ion engine, stolen from a Nebulon-B, that was powered by three [[Quadex/Legends|Quadex]] [[Power core/Legends|power cores]].<ref name="EGVV" />
